job: สำนักงานกระจุกอยู่ตรงไหน ค่าเช่าที่ประกาศเท่าไร และใกล้รถไฟฟ้าแค่ไหน — แล้วเจาะลงถึงเขต สถานี องค์กร และสำนักงาน
audiences: ทีมอสังหาริมทรัพย์ขององค์กรและผู้เช่าสำนักงาน
เจ้าของอาคาร ผู้พัฒนา และนักลงทุนอสังหาริมทรัพย์
ผู้ให้บริการพื้นที่ทำงานและนายหน้า
ทีมวิเคราะห์ ที่ปรึกษา และ agent
journey: switch the measure (สำนักงาน | ค่าเช่า)
district → categories, evidence, floors, stations, organisations, offices and their rents
office → building view, facts, ค่าเช่ารอบ ๆ

kept: basemap, massing tiers, building units (15 % rule), terrain mode, camera presets, 2-point building view, x-ray, MapLibre 5.6.2 guards
district/province frames and production codes, breadcrumb and deep links
Aha shape (≤ 3 districts, tie rule, rail bars, outside finding), row scopes, panel modes and provenance line
owner standing rules: 41-sample LDS ramps, no caveat on screen, icons over text, one symbol per row, phone dock, Google actions as plain search
replaced: measures: rooms | records → offices | median dated asking rent (RENT_MIN_N = 5)
scales: li.supply + count → count + price (LDS 0.9.7, no LI profile scale)
categories: accommodation groups → office_supply_model groups; evidence filter added (qualification_status)
comparison set: same group, ½–2× rooms, 2 km → offices with an asking rent within 1 km
symbol size: ∝ rooms → one size for every office
labels: rooms + recorded price percentiles → floors + asking-rent percentiles
dropped: brand logos, current names, resort sites, retail context (Shopping centers), meeting rooms, terrain fact chips

rowScopes.scopeRows: rows after search · category · evidence · floors · province · organisation, before any district selection or focus: the comparison base of the Aha, the choropleth, the charts and every rank
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected เขต/อำเภอ
rowScopes.rows: baseRows narrowed by the district focus: pins with detail, counters, the table (a building, station or organisation panel shows its own rows)

firstAha.ranking: count: เขต/อำเภอ by offices inside the home province = the province holding the most offices placed at district level; rent: by the median of dated asking rents (n ≥ RENT_MIN_N) inside the province holding the most dated rents; up to three and never every district holding the measure (N ≤ 3 → top N − 1); never cut through a tie — a tie at the cut joins while the focus stays ≤ 4 and leaves a district out, otherwise only the districts above it; none left → spread
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {share}% ของสำนักงานใน{home} อยู่ใน {n} {เขต|อำเภอ}นี้ (one district: อยู่ใน{เขต|อำเภอ}{name}) · rent: {เขต|อำเภอ}ที่ค่าเช่ากลางสูงสุดใน{home} + each median with its n
firstAha.numerator: count: offices of the focused districts (matched membership); rent: each district’s median with its n (no share)
firstAha.denominator: count: every office of the home province in the selection (homeValue: rows with a district and rows placed only at province level); rent: the home province’s median of every dated rent, n stated
firstAha.personality: rail: count — two bars, the share of offices within 500 m (straight line) of an operating CityMETER Transit station among the focus offices with a point vs the rest of the province’s placed offices with a point, both bases in each bar’s title and accessible text; rent — the median of dated rents within 500 m vs farther in the province, n of each side; hidden when neither side has any
firstAha.secondaryFinding: the district(s) with the most offices (rent: the highest median) outside the home province, every tied district; hidden with a province filter
firstAha.defaultCamera: city preset, fitPitched over the focused districts
firstAha.action: ดูทุกพื้นที่ (?areas=all); เปรียบเทียบพื้นที่ (opens charts); district names are links

outside.name: เมืองเชียงใหม่

fallbacks.noRows: “ไม่พบสำนักงานตามตัวกรองนี้” + ล้างตัวกรอง
fallbacks.spread: every district of the home province holds the same value: “{n} {เขต}ใน{home} มีสำนักงานเท่ากัน”
fallbacks.unplaced: rows without a district: “n แห่ง · ไม่ระบุเขต/อำเภอ”
fallbacks.rentNone: “ยังไม่มี{เขต|อำเภอ}ที่มีราคาประกาศครบ 5 รายการในตัวกรองนี้” + the national n and median + ดูจำนวนสำนักงาน
fallbacks.explicit: ?areas=a,b,c: the chosen districts, their offices (rent: median with n when ≥ 5)

countingUnitContract.rule: one row = one Office ID (an office premises, building or component; a workspace centre in a host building is its own record; never a building count); the sheet’s aggregate references with child rows are out of every figure (meta.excluded, 4 rows); an undated rent or a legacy production price never enters the rent measure

metricContract.areas: count: offices per เขต/อำเภอ (LDS count); rent: the median of the dated asking rents of the district’s offices (LDS price)
metricContract.provinces: the same measure per province frame (offices; median of dated rents)
metricContract.eligibility: rent: a median only from RENT_MIN_N = 5 dated rents (js/model.js#valueOf); fewer is no_data with its n; count: none (totals)
metricContract.combined: count: Σ focus ÷ the home province’s offices in the selection (homeValue, a share with numerator and denominator); rent: no combined figure — each district’s median beside the province’s
metricContract.notDrawn: no per-area or per-person ratio, no average rent, no Σ rent; floor area is never summed
metricContract.ramp: all 41 samples of the family LUT by rank among the measured values being read (js/scales.js#buildRamp; owner standing rule “Color scale ขอให้ใช้ 41 scales ตาม LDS เสมอ”); map, legend, labels, rank bars and the district chart read one ramp; the matrix has its own ramp over its cells

coverageContract.covered: every เขต/อำเภอ of the 77 provinces is in the register’s national scope; the register is a research master, not a census

states.measured_zero: count only: sample 0 + zero outline — no office of the dataset is placed there under the filters
states.no_data: rent only: the district has offices but fewer than 5 dated rents (hatch; reason “ราคาประกาศ n รายการ” or “ไม่มีราคาประกาศ”)
states.out_of_scope: rent only: no office in the district (not drawn)
states.suppressed: not used (a suppressed value would still leak through the per-office rents)

coverageContract.unplaced: rows without a district are counted apart (province only), never shown as 0

mapFocusContract.choropleth: count (offices) or price (median asking rent), 41-sample ramp by rank, under the basemap’s first line layer; zoom 8–14.5; the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4; measured_zero = sample 0 + 2 px zero outline; no_data = hatch (districts and province frames)

source.rule: operating = on the operator roster of CityMETER · Transit; construction = a project station, not a service; straight-line distance from the office point to the station reference point, up to 2000 m

rail.drawn: operating stations as quiet rings from zoom 10.5 (names from 13.5), clickable → station panel; the open station’s 500 m radius dashed
rail.office: nearest operating station within 2 km and nearest station under construction (words only), linked to the same station in CityMETER Transit by id

contextContract.distances: straight lines between reference points — never a walking route, travel time or catchment

compsetContract.rule: offices with a starting asking rent (dated or not) whose point lies within 1,000 m straight line, nearest first, up to 8, every row of the dataset
compsetContract.around: every office with a point within 1,000 m and the median of their dated rents when n ≥ 5
compsetContract.words: ค่าเช่ารอบ ๆ · rule as chips (มีค่าเช่าที่ประกาศ · ≤ 1 กม.); never คู่แข่ง or a valuation; the limits live behind “วิธีนับ”

rentContract.field: 28_OFFICE_METRICS.rent_min_thb_sqm_month (rent_max when stated), rent_source_date month, rent_basis, rent_source_url
rentContract.period: listing month 2026-05 to 2026-10 (256 dated of 276); undated rents per office only
rentContract.shown: per office: fact chip “฿x–y /ตร.ม./เดือน · เดือน”, panel, labels, comparison set, table; per area: median with n
rentContract.words: ค่าเช่าที่ประกาศ · ค่าเช่ากลาง (median) · n ราคา; the basis in the chip title
rentContract.never: called a contract, achieved, average or market rent; summed or averaged; 0 for a missing rent
rentContract.legacy: legacy_rent_min/max of CityMETER production (THB/m², period not stated): “ราคาที่บันทึก (เดิม)” per office only where no monthly rent is selected (72 rows), never in a measure

buildingJoinContract.click: one office → the office; several → the building panel “สำนักงานในอาคารนี้” (“สูงราว”, the outline source in the title and the provenance line)

interactionContract.keyboard: roving tabindex over HTML pins from zoom 15.5; roving tablist for chart views; arrow keys on the measure switch; visible focus everywhere

massingContract.cityTier: basemap building extrusions, quiet, faded with distance from the focus; OpenFreeMap features replaced by CityMETER buildings are hidden (one hashed match) and their buildings outside the focus come back in a context layer drawn the same way
massingContract.focusTier: rounded footprints from z14 tiles in the focus regions (≤ 16 tiles nearest the camera; from zoom 12 in 3D when complete, else 13): OpenStreetMap, or CityMETER Building V4 tiles (≤ 40 requests, per อปท. or แขวง) inside CityMETER units
massingContract.hostTier: unused (no host geometry in this product)
massingContract.enclosure: encloseOffsetM keeps the rounded shape around the original outline
massingContract.buildingSource: per unit from data/building-units/ (the CityMETER · Hotel 0.3.6 files, unchanged; scripts/build-building-units.py): CityMETER Building V4 when its count ≥ 1.15 × the OSM count of the unit (owner 2026-11-01), else OSM; OSM buildings mapped in parts stay inside CityMETER units; a missing CityMETER tile leaves its part on OSM; a unit the files do not list draws OSM
massingContract.terrain: fill-extrusions stand on the terrain at their centroid (MapLibre); the building camera fits on the anchor's ground plane and the landed centre's ground; the x-ray solid is lifted the same way

presets.model: pitch 60 · fov 14 (district, office without a point)
presets.eye: pitch 75 · fov 24 (the building view: building, office with a point)

cameraContract.fitting: fitPitched (overview, district): flat fit, then zoom out until every outline vertex is inside the padded viewport, then in while it still fits; pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3

buildingView.owner: 2026-10-29 19:47 “อาคารที่เลือก หรือ on focus ให้แสดงด้วยมุมมอง 2-point perspective เสมอ zoom to fit viewport เสมอด้วย”
buildingView.module: js/shell/camera.js#fitBuilding, twoPointBearing, wallAzimuth, occlusionScore, screenBounds (from CityMETER · Shopping centers); js/app.js#frameFocus
buildingView.target: js/app.js#focusTarget — the open building (building mode); the building the open office’s point falls in, else (the Hotel 0.3.2 rule, owner 2026-11-02 “เวลาคลิกที่ poi hotel แล้วต้องแสดง 2-point perspective ของ 3d building mass ทุกกรณีสิ”, carried to Office) the drawn building nearest the office’s point: js/shell/building-join.js#nearestBuilding — distance from the point to the outline on a local plane, within 300 m (OFFICE_REACH_M), the largest piece within 10 m of the nearest; when nothing is drawn within 300 m the focus tier is loaded once more for 800 m round the point (OFFICE_REACH_FAR_M); legend “อาคารใกล้หมุด”, framed with the point (one zoom step wider, maxZoom 20); a camera choice only, never a join, a count or a located-in claim
buildingView.bearing: dominant wall azimuth + 45°, on the diagonal where the drawn focus buildings (massing.obstaclesNear, 400 m) hide least of it, then the one nearest the current bearing
buildingView.fit: eye preset; shift lens (0.3.2, js/shell/camera.js#lensPadding): padding moves the principal point up to the free box’s centre, never below the canvas centre (pitch + fov/2 < 90 keeps the horizon out), so the camera looks straight at the building at pitch 75 on a phone’s strip above the sheet as on a desktop; fit points = the pieces as the focus tier draws them at building zoom (massing.fitPointsOf → js/massing.js#footprintFitPoints: the offset and fillets of zoom 18, ground and roof), never the shape drawn at the starting zoom (up to 3.6 m wider on every side); every one inside the free box (js/app.js#visibleBox: below the toolbar, above the Aha card, legend, chart tray, table or open phone sheet, left of the zoom control), one side filling 94% of it; maxZoom 21 when the building is known (js/shell/camera.js#BUILDING_MAX_ZOOM — Hotel 0.3.2: small buildings; the Shopping centers limit 19.5 left a 40 m building at half the box) / 18 while unknown, minZoom 14
buildingView.unknown: a 90 m box round the point (12 m tall) framed the same way while the buildings load, and where nothing is drawn within 800 m; the camera turns to the building when it arrives, at most three times, never after a user camera move
buildingView.plan: 3D off: the same footprint fitted flat (fitPitched plan, maxZoom 21 known / 18 unknown)
buildingView.click: selectOffice (pin, label, list row, search, comparison set) and selectBuilding switch the map to 3D (js/app.js#ensure3d) before framing; a link keeps view3d=0 when it asks for it
buildingView.terrain: on terrain each fit point carries the ground it is drawn on (4th value: roof at the piece centroid’s ground, base at the lowest ground under its outline, the pin at its own ground); fitBuilding damps its landed rounds (half steps) and js/shell/maplibre-guard.js#guardElevationFreeze lands the centre on the ground after every programmatic ease (MapLibre 5.6.2 leaves map._elevationFreeze on); refitted when the ground changes by ≥ 3 m, a new building arrives or the free box changes once the camera is still (js/app.js#watchFreeBox: legend, trays, phone sheet), at most 3 times, never after a user camera move
buildingView.lift: 0.3.2: MapLibre 5.6.2 lifts a camera that would stand inside the terrain (Map#_elevateCameraIfInsideTerrain: lower pitch, other zoom) on every jump; fitBuilding computes with it off (withoutLift) and asks MapLibre’s own check about the camera it found — the alternates (the other corners, opposite first: js/app.js#frameFocus) when that camera would be lifted, else the pitch MapLibre allows; the target carries its pitch and the centre’s elevation (an instant jump checks from the right height)

tileCoverGuard.bug: MapLibre GL JS 5.6.2 SourceCache._updateRetainedTiles checks the four children of a missing ideal tile whenever the cover zoom + 1 ≤ the source maxzoom; a pitched cover can already hold an ideal tile at the maxzoom, whose children() is ONE overscaled child; when that child is retained, children[1] is undefined and the frame throws “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'key')”
tileCoverGuard.seen: live 2026-10-29 (Claude desktop browser, real OpenFreeMap tiles): openmaptiles (vector, maxzoom 14), cover zoom 13, camera 13.79–13.95, pitch 75, while the building camera flew between branches; reproduced in the build container by stepping the pitched camera out from 19.5 to 13.6 over a building (7–8 errors on 0.2.0, 0 with the guard)
tileCoverGuard.fix: pad the child list of exactly those ideal tiles to four copies of the overscaled child, so the check reads as MapLibre's own overzoom branch; installed on the shared SourceCache prototype at every style load; only for version 5.6.2
tileCoverGuard.elevationFreeze: js/shell/maplibre-guard.js#guardElevationFreeze(map, version), 0.3.2: MapLibre 5.6.2 easeTo/flyTo on terrain without freezeElevation leave map._elevationFreeze on (only a gesture or _finalizeElevation clears it), so the render loop stops clamping the centre to the ground and the framed building drifts (seen 2026-11-02: camera 80.97 m vs ground 62.41 m at Sri Panwa); the guard wraps map._afterEase: when the ease ended (not superseded) and no terrain gesture is running, it clears the freeze and sets the centre elevation to the ground; only for version 5.6.2 (tests/maplibre-guard.test.js)

venueXrayContract.owner: 2026-10-29 19:47 “เช็คอย่าให้ 3d building mass ตึกอื่นบังอาคารที่กำลังดูอยู่”
venueXrayContract.module: js/shell/venue-xray.js#installVenueXray(map, {beforeId, toMercator, colors}) → {update(features, {colors}), setEnabled, hitTest(point), dispose, count, enabled, failed} (from CityMETER · Shopping centers / Luxury Brands)
venueXrayContract.layer: venue-xray (custom, renderingMode 3d) before place-quarter (js/shell/map-style.js#VENUE_XRAY_BEFORE): drawn over every building and over road names
venueXrayContract.input: the features of the building being looked at (massing.featuresOf(target.refs)) with display_height_m / display_base_m; on terrain the roof is lifted by the ground at the piece centroid (as MapLibre lifts fill-extrusions) and the walls go down to the lowest ground under the outline (0.3.2; a fixed 10 m showed through the slope)
venueXrayContract.depth: scissored depth clear inside the building’s screen box, then its own depth test
venueXrayContract.seeThrough: massing.setScene('eye', rings): the focus buildings standing in front of it turn see-through (SCENE.eye)
venueXrayContract.labels: district label chips never sit on the building (refreshLabelView avoid box), nor do the offices’ name labels (js/labels.js#installOfficeLabels avoid → buildingScreenBox)
venueXrayContract.visibility: 3D only, zoom ≥ 13 (XRAY_MIN_ZOOM); empty outside the building view
venueXrayContract.colours: map.activeLayer faces, map.selectedStroke edges — map roles, not data colours
venueXrayContract.failSafe: a GL error disables it (failed = true); the massing highlight keeps drawing
venueXrayContract.geojsonMaxzoom: every GeoJSON source uses maxzoom 24 (js/map-layers.js#GEOJSON_MAXZOOM, the most geojson-vt allows), two levels above BUILDING_MAX_ZOOM: MapLibre 5.6.2 throws in SourceCache._updateRetainedTiles when the near tiles of a pitched cover reach a GeoJSON source maxzoom before they have data (seen in CityMETER · Shopping centers 2026-10-25); under the eye preset the near tiles sit up to about half a level above the camera (tests/release.test.js)

invariants.rule: an office record is never called a building; a count of offices is never a count of buildings or floor area
a rent is “ค่าเช่าที่ประกาศ”; never a contract, achieved, average or market rent; never 0 for a missing rent
an area median needs ≥ 5 dated rents and always shows its n; fewer is no_data with its n
undated rents and legacy production prices are per office only, never in a measure
membership is the district matched at build time (row.admin); never re-assigned on screen
distances are straight lines between reference points; never walking time or catchment
the Aha never cuts a tie and never focuses every district holding the measure
every panel view ends with exactly one provenance line and the “วิธีนับ” link; no caveat on screen
one symbol = one office with a point, one size for every office; never clustered
organisations join by id only; a role is a source claim, never a tenancy or ownership check
colours only from assets/theme.css, js/scales.js, js/cues.js; 41 samples by rank; same HEX on both themes
no address, phone, raw record, researcher text, private document link or Landometer commercial term in the repository
